questions.q: What position did Silver say he held on Flint's ship?
questions.evidence: Flint was cap'n; I was quartermaster

questions.q: According to Silver, what happened to Pew in the same broadside that cost Silver his leg?
questions.evidence: The same broadside I lost my leg, old Pew lost his deadlights.

questions.q: How was Silver different from Pew in handling his money?
choices: Silver saved his money, while Pew spent his and ended up starving
Silver spent everything, while Pew saved
Both buried their money on the island
Neither of them ever had any money
questions.evidence: 'Tain't earning now, it's saving does it

questions.q: Why was Jim so angry when he heard Silver tell the young sailor he was "as smart as paint"?
choices: Silver had used the very same flattery on Jim
It was an insult in sailor talk
Jim wanted the young sailor's job
Silver said it about the captain
questions.evidence: the very same words of flattery as he had used to myself

questions.q: What did Silver and the others really mean by a "gentleman of fortune"?
questions.evidence: By a "gentleman of fortune" they plainly meant neither more nor less than a common pirate

questions.q: Where did Silver say his money from the Bristol banks was now?
choices: With his wife, who was off to meet him
questions.evidence: my old missis has it all by now

questions.q: What was the name of the young sailor Silver won over?
Who was the third man who joined Silver and Dick?
questions.evidence: returned the voice of the coxswain, Israel Hands

questions.q: Why did Silver want to wait as long as possible before taking over the ship?
choices: He needed the squire and doctor to find the treasure and the captain to sail them home
He was afraid of Israel Hands
He wanted to be sure Jim was on their side
He was waiting for his wife's ship
questions.evidence: I mean this squire and doctor shall find the stuff, and help us to get it aboard

questions.q: What did Silver vote should be done with the honest men once the treasure was aboard?
What did Silver ask Dick to fetch, which terrified Jim?
questions.evidence: get me an apple, to wet my pipe like

questions.q: What did Jim figure out when Silver gave Dick the key to the rum keg?
choices: That this was how Mr. Arrow had got his drink
That Silver was the ship's captain
That Dick was a spy for the squire
questions.evidence: this must have been how Mr. Arrow got the strong waters that destroyed him

questions.q: What hopeful news did Jim learn from Israel's whisper, "Not another man of them'll jine"?
choices: There were still faithful men on board
The pirates had given up their plan
The captain knew about the plot
questions.evidence: Hence there were still faithful men on board.
